areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: A product finances implementation and expansion of sanitation systems, especially sewerage.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities

areas.name: Education and health conditions

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
